# Bash4LLM⁺

> Zero-dependency POSIX Bash client framework for secure, low-latency Large Language Model (LLM) inference, SSE streaming, persistent conversation threads, interactive TUI chat, and OpenSSL AES-256 encrypted key management.

Bash4LLM⁺ operates entirely on standard POSIX base system utilities, `curl`, and `jq`, requiring zero external language runtimes (no Python, Node.js, Docker, or pip/npm modules). It provides sub-10ms cold-start execution times across GNU/Linux, macOS, BSD, WSL, Cygwin, and Android (Termux).

Key architectural security invariants include zero dynamic shell `eval`, zero process table secret leaking (passing Bearer tokens via unlinked file descriptors `/dev/fd/3`), zero shared directory usage (isolated private execution folders under `umask 077`), memory-locked guard functions (`readonly -f`), and Ed25519 manifest signature verification (`manifest.sha256.sig`) with anti-TOCTOU staging copy isolation.

## Core Documentation & Specifications

- [Architecture Specification (English)](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/docs/bash4llm-arch-spec-en.md): Primary system architecture, execution pipeline, runtime constraints, and security design principles.
- [Architecture Specification (Italian)](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/docs/bash4llm-arch-spec.md): Technical specification of the internal engine, bootstrap sequences, and module layout.
- [Timeless Architecture Specification](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/docs/timeless/timeless-arc-spec.md): Core architectural invariants, negative constraints, and immutable system design rules.
- [Timeless Testing Specification](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/docs/timeless/timeless-test-spec.md): QA test standards, compliance suites, and execution invariants.

## Security & Vault Infrastructure

- [Security Specification (English)](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/SECURITY-en.md): Threat model, security guarantees, token redaction, and vulnerability reporting.
- [Security Specification (Italian)](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Italian security policy specification and threat boundaries.
- [OpenSSL Encrypted Vault Guide](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/extras/security/OPENSSL-HELPER.md): OpenSSL AES-256-CBC PBKDF2 vault operations, RAM context session unlocking, and policy enforcement (`BASH4LLM_REQUIRE_VAULT=1`).

## Providers & Extensions

- [LLM Providers Specification](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/PROVIDERS.md): Provider API contracts, trust domains (`builtin`, `vendor`, `local`), and dynamic module verification for Groq, Gemini, Mistral, and Hugging Face.
- [Hugging Face Module Specification](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/extras/providers/huggingface.md): Module configuration and payload mapping for Hugging Face Inference API.

## Session Engine & Interactive TUI

- [Interactive TUI REPL Specification](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/extras/chat/SPEC-TUI.md): Design and protocol specification for the interactive terminal chat interface (`extras/chat/tui-repl.sh`).
- [Session Context Engine Documentation](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/extras/session/README.md): Multi-turn session persistence, NDJSON history formats, SHA-256 `SAFE_THREAD_ID` hashing, and context window truncation.

## QA, Test Suite & Diagnostics

- [Test Suite Overview](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/extras/test/README-tests.md): Master test runner (`run-all-tests.sh`) orchestration, including sanity, compatibility, regression, hardening, concurrency, stress, and scintilla-t3 tests.
- [Core Technical Notes](https://github.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/blob/main/extras/docs/core-notes.sh): Executable technical note script detailing internal helper functions and diagnostic mappings.
